name: Sean Kim
headline: Statistics, Economics, and CS @ Waterloo
intro: Statistics student at the University of Waterloo, with minors in Computer Science and Economics. I’ve lived in seven cities on four continents and now call Toronto home.
bio: I’ve lived in seven cities on four continents — Seoul, Fairfax, Geneva, Dakar, Moscow and Kuala Lumpur — before landing in Toronto.
Now I study Statistics at Waterloo with minors in CS and Economics, and spend most of my time where software, data and finance overlap.
Off duty: Formula 1, drumming, golf, poker, bartending.
program: Honours Bachelor of Mathematics in Statistics
availability: Open to co-op and internship roles
lookingFor: I’m open to co-op and internship roles in software, data and finance. Email is the fastest way to reach me.
